posts.title: Welcome to the lab
posts.excerpt: Stories, tech notes, and project logs — written in public, edited when the compile finishes.
posts.body:
## Why this exists

This blog is my public notebook: **stories**, **thoughts**, **new tech**, and **project logs** — things I've shipped, things I'm building, and things still living in the backlog.

Expect a mix of Hardware and Software, occasional weekend tangents that somehow turn into something more in-depth.

## How it works

Posts live as structured data on this site. I write them from the admin desk when something is worth saying out loud.

If you're here from the portfolio — welcome. Stay for the builds and brain-matter.
